briefings.title: The future of U.S. foreign policy: Competing with China, U.S. reliability and a new warfare era

people.name: Linda Thomas-Greenfield
people.role: US Ambassador to the United Nations

briefings.tldr: To successfully compete with systemic rivals like China and navigate a new era of high-tech warfare, the United States must abandon unilateralism, rebuild its damaged international credibility, and foster agile, issue-specific global alliances.

briefings.title: Former Secretary Of State Antony Blinken, Andy Kim Discuss The Future Of American Foreign Policy
briefings.tldr: To successfully counter China's rising global influence and navigate a rapidly shifting world order, the United States must rebuild its domestic and international credibility by prioritizing diplomatic reliability and forming flexible, issue-specific multilateral alliances rather than relying on unilateral actions.
